name: The adverb of time and place (ẓarf, mafʿūl fīh)
definition: A noun of time or place in naṣb, with the meaning of 'in' understood: al-yawma, today; amāma, in front.
body: Al-Ājurrūmiyya defines the ẓarf of time as the noun of time in naṣb 'by supposing fī': ṣumtu al-yawma means I fasted on (fī) the day. Its lists: al-yawma, al-laylata, ghudwatan, bukratan, saḥaran, ghadan … and for place amāma, khalfa, quddāma, warāʾa, fawqa, taḥta, ʿinda, maʿa …
When fī is said, the noun is no longer a ẓarf but in jarr after the particle.
